# `viewport/ViewportRaycasting.js`

> **Source:** `editor/js/viewport/ViewportRaycasting.js`

ViewportRaycasting.js - Pure raycasting math utilities Extracted from Viewport.js for modularity

## Functions

### `rayGroundPlaneIntersect(rayOrigin, rayDir, planeY = 0)`

Ray-ground plane intersection

**Parameters:**

- `rayOrigin` *(number[])* — Ray origin [x, y, z]
- `rayDir` *(number[])* — Ray direction (normalized) [x, y, z]
- `planeY` *(number)* — Y coordinate of ground plane

**Returns:** |null}

### `raySegmentDistance(rayOrigin, rayDir, segA, segB)`

Calculate distance from ray to line segment (for rope picking)

**Parameters:**

- `rayOrigin` *(number[])* — Ray origin
- `rayDir` *(number[])* — Ray direction
- `segA` *(number[])* — Segment start point
- `segB` *(number[])* — Segment end point

**Returns:** |null}

### `raySphereIntersect(rayOrigin, rayDir, sphereCenter, radius)`

Ray-sphere intersection test

**Parameters:**

- `rayOrigin` *(number[])* — Ray origin
- `rayDir` *(number[])* — Ray direction
- `sphereCenter` *(number[])* — Sphere center
- `radius` *(number)* — Sphere radius

**Returns:** Distance to hit or null

### `rotatePointByQuaternion(point, quat)`

Rotate a point by quaternion

**Parameters:**

- `point` *(number[])* — Point [x, y, z]
- `quat` *(number[])* — Quaternion [x, y, z, w]

### `multiplyQuaternions(a, b)`

Multiply two quaternions: result = a * b

**Parameters:**

- `a` *(number[])* — First quaternion [x, y, z, w]
- `b` *(number[])* — Second quaternion [x, y, z, w]

### `rayOBBIntersect(rayOrigin, rayDir, boxCenter, boxRotation, halfExtents)`

Ray-OBB (Oriented Bounding Box) intersection

**Parameters:**

- `rayOrigin` *(number[])* — Ray origin
- `rayDir` *(number[])* — Ray direction
- `boxCenter` *(number[])* — Box center
- `boxRotation` *(number[])* — Box rotation quaternion [x, y, z, w]
- `halfExtents` *(number[])* — Box half extents [x, y, z]

**Returns:** |null}

### `closestPointOnAxis(rayOrigin, rayDir, axisOrigin, axisDir)`

Closest point on axis from ray

**Parameters:**

- `rayOrigin` *(number[])* — Ray origin
- `rayDir` *(number[])* — Ray direction
- `axisOrigin` *(number[])* — Axis origin
- `axisDir` *(number[])* — Axis direction

**Returns:** |null}

## Notes & Examples

### Editor Extension System

The editor supports extensions via the same Plauna component system as apps. Extensions can add panels, tools, menu items, and hooks into the engine. They run with elevated 'editor' capability granting access to the scene graph, asset database, and build pipeline.

**Example: Editor extension adding a custom panel**
```js
import { Extension } from 'editor/core/Extension.js';
import { Panel } from 'editor/ui/Panel.js';

class TerrainEditor extends Extension {
  id = 'terrain-editor';
  capabilities = ['editor', 'scene'];
  
  activate(context) {
    // Add menu item
    context.menus.add('Tools/Terrain', () => this.open());
    
    // Register tool
    context.tools.register('terrain', {
      icon: 'mountain',
      onSelect: (entity) => this.edit(entity)
    });
  }
  
  open() {
    this.panel = new Panel({
      title: 'Terrain Editor',
      content: this.buildUI()
    });
    context.workspace.addPanel(this.panel);
  }
  
  edit(entity) {
    const terrain = entity.get(TerrainComponent);
    this.panel.bind(terrain);
  }
}

editor.extensions.register(TerrainEditor);
```

**See also:** [Editor Overview](/editor/overview.md)
